# threads-private-api Documentation

> Headless Threads (com.instagram.barcelona) Mobile Private API SDK for Python & TypeScript.

## Core Capabilities
- Sub-80ms real-time keyword search across public Threads discussions.
- Ingest complete nested discussion trees (parent, root, replies, quotes).
- Reply directly to ANY external thread post (impossible with official Graph API).
- Dual presets: Threads iOS (iPhone 15 Pro, iOS 17.6.1) and Threads Android (Samsung Galaxy A34, Android 14).
- Unified Meta authentication format: Bearer IGT:2:...
- Dual SDK: Python (threadsflow) and TypeScript (@molkex/threads-private-api).

## Python Usage
```python
from threadsflow import ThreadsAPI, ThreadsSession

threads = ThreadsAPI(device_preset="threads_ios")
posts = threads.search_posts("artificial intelligence", limit=10)
tree = threads.get_thread("3141592653589793238")
reply_res = threads.reply(parent_post_id="3141592653589793238", text="Agreed!")
```

## TypeScript Usage
```typescript
import { ThreadsAPI, ThreadsSession } from "@molkex/threads-private-api";

const threads = new ThreadsAPI({ devicePreset: "threads_ios" });
const posts = await threads.searchPosts("artificial intelligence", 10);
const tree = await threads.getThread("3141592653589793238");
await threads.reply("3141592653589793238", "Agreed!");
```
